CREATE TRIGGER irrigation_v2_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.irrigation_decision_logs FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION irrigation_v2_deny_audit_mutation()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.irrigation_v2_deny_audit_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IRRIGATION_AUDIT_APPEND_ONLY';
END
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER irrigation_v2_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.irrigation_decision_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION irrigation_v2_deny_audit_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER irrigation_v2_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.irrigation_decision_logs FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION irrigation_v2_deny_audit_mutation()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.irrigation_v2_deny_audit_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IRRIGATION_AUDIT_APPEND_ONLY';
END
$function$
